question: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Dependence".
solution:
The correct answer is: **1) Autonomy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dependence"** means the state of relying on or needing someone or something for support or aid. (निर्भरता)
 
 
• **Example:** The child's dependence on her parents was evident in her constant need for reassurance.
 
 
• **"Autonomy"** refers to the ability to make one's own decisions without relying on others; it denotes self-sufficiency or independence. (स्वायत्तता)
 
 
• **Example:** The country gained autonomy after years of struggle against colonial rule.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the opposite of **'Dependence'** is **'Autonomy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **1) Autonomy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Slavery** (गुलामी): A condition in which someone is forced to work for another under harsh conditions without freedom.
 
 
• **Example:** Slavery was abolished in many parts of the world in the 19th century.
 
 
 
• **Subordinate** (अधीनस्थ): A person under the authority or control of another; someone of a lower rank.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager assigned the task to her subordinate to complete by the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Submissiveness** (आज्ञाकारिता): The quality of being willing to obey someone without resistance.
 
 
• **Example:** Her submissiveness was mistaken for a lack of confidence.
 
 

**Question:** Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Dependence".

**Correct Answer:** 1) Autonomy
